categories.AR_TF_both_rejected: first two branches with both B-AR and B-TF H4 rejected
categories.AR_rejected_TF_recovered: first two branches with rejected B-AR H4 and accepted B-TF H4
categories.contact_h4_rejected: all saved contact-by-H4 branches with B-AR H4 joint rejection
categories.matched_hold_control: available hold for first contact and first rotation selected anchor
categories.noncontact_hold_control: first two noncontact hold branches with B-AR and B-TF H4 accepted
categories.rotation_gt5_h4_rejected: all branches with wrapped true H4 rotation >5deg and B-AR H4 rejection

rules.color_residual: minimum RGB RMS/255 distance to fixed source/output palette segments, display scale[0,.10]
rules.display: clip[0,1], round*255 uint8, nearest pixels; never fed to fitting/model/scoring
rules.fit_residual: abs(frozen RGB chromatic alpha - original stored candidate rigid template), fixed scale[0,1]
rules.truth_use: posthoc stratum labels and separately colored outlines only; never template fitting/selection by visual appeal
